query: Show me what happens when a user submits the login form.
setup: Repository contains a login form handler that calls three internal functions in sequence
One of those functions is defined in a different module than the handler
expected_behavior: Reads the handler and the functions it calls before producing any view
Produces a single call tree in a text fence with only the functions on the submit path
Uses only function names that exist in the repository; marks anything unresolved with `?`
Keeps prose to at most two lines around the view
Ends with one line offering a zoom in, zoom out, or alternate view
